  DETAILED FINDINGS
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  🔴 [CRITICAL] Interface 'wan1' (wan): Telnet enabled — cleartext management. Remove immediately. CLI: config system interface → edit wan1 → set allowaccess (list without telnet)
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Interface 'wan1' (wan): HTTP enabled — cleartext management. Replace with HTTPS only.
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Interface 'wan1' (wan): SNMP enabled — WAN-facing SNMP is critical risk.
  🟠 [HIGH] Interface 'wan1' (WAN): SSH exposed to internet — restrict via local-in-policy to admin IPs only.
  🟠 [HIGH] Interface 'wan1' (WAN): HTTPS management on WAN — restrict via local-in-policy or remove from allowaccess.
  🟡 [MEDIUM] Interface 'wan1' (WAN): ICMP ping enabled — aids attacker recon. Disable on WAN.
  🟠 [HIGH] Interface 'wan1' exposure score 7.0/10 (HIGH EXPOSURE) — significant management attack surface. Review and restrict.
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Interface 'dmz' (dmz): Telnet enabled — cleartext management. Remove immediately. CLI: config system interface → edit dmz → set allowaccess (list without telnet)
  🟠 [HIGH] Interface 'dmz' (dmz): HTTP enabled — cleartext management. Replace with HTTPS only.
